summary: Sandbach United are sitting pretty at the top of the NWCFL table and will look to make it back-to-back wins over Alsagertown this Saturday, hoping to build on last week's strong derby attendance of 181. The club continues to be well-represented in the goalscoring charts, with Joe Bevan among the league's top strikers on 135 goals for the season, giving the Reds plenty of firepower in their title push.
